svg.title: AI Command Gateway: Historical Azure pilot - ARCH-004 v0.4
svg.desc: Historical verified pilot and reference architecture. The deployed Azure foundation, job, registry image, cloud data copies, monitoring and network resources were retired after the temporary operator path was removed. The subscription, local code, five original datasets, reviewed local image and downloaded evidence are preserved. Four bounded pilot modes were verified before retirement, including the expected safe configuration failure. Solid paths show historical runtime; dashed paths show historical transfer and access. No deployed pilot service is represented. Production gates remain open.

g.text: Cloud resources retired - subscription and local assets retained
